title: Researchers Uncover a Bathhouse Complex in Ancient Pompeii
titleZh: 研究人员在古庞贝发现一处浴场建筑群
credits: The Associated Press reported this story. Caty Weaver adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: Archeological research has uncovered another treasure of the ancient Roman city of Pompeii: a large private bathhouse.
sentences.zh: 考古研究在古罗马城市庞贝又发现了一件珍宝：一座大型私人浴场。

sentences.en: The explosion of Mount Vesuvius in 70 AD buried Pompeii in thick ash, wreckage, and lava, or hot liquid rock.
sentences.zh: 公元70年维苏威火山爆发，将庞贝掩埋在厚厚的灰烬、残骸和熔岩，即炽热的液态岩石之中。

sentences.en: Archeologists are continuing to find remains of the city under the ground.
sentences.zh: 考古学家们仍在继续发掘这座城市地下的遗迹。

sentences.en: The bathhouse was part of a large private house, the scientists said.
sentences.zh: 科学家称，这座浴场是一座大型私人宅邸的一部分。

sentences.en: The bathhouse holds a series of rooms that would have provided hot, warm, or cold conditions.
sentences.zh: 浴场内有一系列房间，原本可提供高温、温和或低温的环境。

sentences.en: The art and design of the complex, including mosaic works, also suggest the owner was wealthy.
sentences.zh: 该建筑群的艺术与设计，包括马赛克装饰，也表明其主人十分富有。

sentences.en: “We have here perhaps the largest thermal complex in a private house in Pompeii,” said Gabriel Zuchtriegel, director of the Pompeii Archaeological Park.
sentences.zh: “我们眼前或许就是庞贝私人宅邸中规模最大的温泉建筑群，”庞贝考古公园馆长加布里埃尔·祖赫特里格尔说道。

sentences.en: He explained that Pompeii’s powerful and wealthy set up large spaces at their homes to hold major gatherings for ceremonies and other purposes.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，庞贝的权贵富贾在宅邸中开辟出大片空间，用于举行仪式及其他用途的大型聚会。

sentences.en: “It was an opportunity to show the wealth in which they lived and also to have a nice thermal treatment," he said.
sentences.zh: “这是一个展示他们优渻生活条件的机会，同时也可以享受一次舒适的温泉浴，”他说道。

sentences.en: The baths were unearthed in the so-called Regio IX, a large central area of Pompeii Park that is still unexplored.
sentences.zh: 这座浴场是在所谓的第九区出土的，这是庞贝公园一个尚未被发掘的大型中心区域。

sentences.en: Recently, archeologists working in the same area found a bakery, a laundry and two homes.
sentences.zh: 最近，在同一区域开展工作的考古学家发现了一座面包房、一座洗衣房和两所住宅。

sentences.en: They also found the bones of three people who died in the volcanic burst.
sentences.zh: 他们还发现了三名在火山爆发中死去的人的骸骨。

sentences.en: Pompeii was not the only city destroyed in the explosion.
sentences.zh: 庞贝并非在这场爆发中被摧毁的唯一城市。

sentences.en: It also buried the city of Herculaneum.
sentences.zh: 火山爆发同样掩埋了赫库兰尼姆城。

sentences.en: Zuchtriegel said wealthy citizens of Pompeii often would first take a bath and then attend a banquet, or a big meal.
sentences.zh: 祖赫特里格尔称，庞贝的富商市民通常会先泡个澡，然后去参加宴会，即一顿丰盛的大餐。

sentences.en: The private thermal complex permitted them to do so together at the home where the banquet was held.
sentences.zh: 这座私人温泉建筑群让他们得以在举办宴会的宅邸中一同完成这一整套流程。

sentences.en: “There is room for about 30 people who could do the whole routine, and that could also be done in public baths.
sentences.zh: “这里能容纳约30人完成整套流程，而这类流程在公共浴场中也能进行。

sentences.en: So there is the caldarium, a very warm environment, and also a large tub with cold water,” he said.
sentences.zh: 这里有卡尔德里乌姆浴房，一个非常温暖的环境，还有一个盛满冷水的大浴盆，”他说道。
